description:
Compact in Place, in a conversation started with the compact_in_place tool off, waits for the current turn to end. The agent is busy running "sleep 30" in the conversation at /c/{{SLUG}}. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}.
2. Click the ".context-usage-label" element.
3. The [data-testid="compact-in-place-button"] button is disabled, and an element with the text "Finish or stop the current turn to compact in place." is visible.
4. Call "cancel": it cancels the agent's turn through the API.
5. The [data-testid="compact-in-place-button"] button becomes enabled.
